source: https://neals.org/about/neals-member-sites/ (directory table is loaded by JavaScript and renders empty to non-browser fetches; data was taken from the directory's individual entry pages https://neals.org/about/neals-member-sites/entry/{id}/ for ids 1402-1570)
notes: 142 U.S. sites (incl. Puerto Rico and DC). The NEALS member directory (GravityView table with columns Title/Site/City/State/Country/Neurologist(s)/Phone/Details) is populated by JavaScript, so the list page itself returned no rows; every single-entry page in the member-site ID block (1402-1570) was fetched instead. That block holds 169 ids: 162 visible member entries (142 U.S. + 20 non-U.S.) and 7 ids (1407, 1462, 1511, 1533, 1546, 1559, 1564) that return 'You are not allowed to view this content' (unpublished/other-form entries, not retrievable). Spot checks of ids outside the block (1300, 1390, 1401, 1572-1575, 1580, 1590, 1600, 1650, 1700, 1800, 1900, 2000, 2100, 2200, 2300, 2350) found no further member entries. The NEALS page says the consortium has 'over 160 members', which matches the 162 visible entries. Field handling: 'name' is the entry Title exactly as listed; 'institution' is the parent hospital/university (same as name where not evident; inferred ones are flagged in notes); city/state/zip were parsed from the entry's Address field; ZIP leading zeros stripped by the site (e.g. '2114') were restored; phones and website URLs are as listed (odd-looking phones are flagged, not corrected). Entry pages show no PI/neurologist names except UNC Chapel Hill. Non-U.S. sites skipped (20): University of British Columbia (Vancouver, BC, Canada); University of Alberta Kaye Edmonton Clinic (KEC) (Edmonton, AB, Canada); CARE Hospitals; Banjara Hills; Hyderabad (Hyderabad, India); Istanbul University (Istanbul, Turkey); Koç University Hospital (Istanbul, Turkey); Akdeniz University (Antalya, Turkey); Hadassah Medical Center (Jerusalem, Israel); Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey (Monterrey, Mexico); Montreal Neurological Institute & Hospital (McGill University) (Montreal, QC, Canada); University of Toronto (Toronto, ON, Canada); University of Western Ontario-London Health Sciences Center (London, ON, Canada); University of Montreal Health Centre (Montreal, QC, Canada); University of Calgary (Calgary, AB, Canada); Brain and Nerve Research Center, Concord Hospital (Concord, NSW, Australia); American University of Beirut (Beirut, Lebanon); Universidad Autonoma de San Luis Potosi (San Luis Potosi, Mexico); University of Milan Medical School at IRCCS Istituto Auxologico Italiano (Milan, Italy); IRCCS-Istituto Mario Negri (Milan, Italy); Neurociencias Estudios Clínicos S.C (Culiacán, Sinaloa, Mexico); Toho University Faculty of Medicine (Tokyo, Japan). Old URLs www.neals.org/about-neals/member-sites and www.neals.org/for-als-mnd-patients/find-a-neals-site no longer resolve; neals.org/wp-json REST API, /csv/ export and tools.neals.org were blocked or redirected.
